38: def _write_access_probe(primitives, generated_path, expected_locked):
39:     # The fixed outer plan must bind this one newly generated path. Never take
40:     # it from IPC, a model manifest, user input or an existing product path.
41:     from win32_worker_connection import _absolute_local_path
42:     _absolute_local_path(generated_path)
43:     value = primitives.api.call("CreateFileW", generated_path, 0x40000000, 7, None, 3, 0x00200000, None)
44:     error = primitives.api.ffi.get_last_error()
45:     invalid = value is None or value == (1 << 64) - 1
46:     if expected_locked:
47:         if not invalid:
48:             handle = primitives._retain(value, "dummy-unexpected-write-access")
49:             primitives._close(handle)
50:         _assert(invalid and error == 32, "generated_file_write_share_guard_not_observed")
51:         return {"write_open_refused": True, "winerror": error}
52:     _assert(not invalid, "generated_file_guard_not_released")
53:     handle = primitives._retain(value, "dummy-postrelease-write-access")
54:     primitives._close(handle)
55:     return {"write_open_succeeded": True, "bytes_written": 0}

58: def _observe_graceful_exit(primitives, worker, expected_exit):
59:     _assert(type(expected_exit) is int and expected_exit in (0, 2), "fixed_generated_child_exit")
60:     _assert(any(item is worker for item in primitives.workers) and worker.assigned
61:             and not worker.unconfirmed and not worker.shutdown_started, "exact_clean_dummy_worker_required")
62:     worker.shutdown_started = True
63:     try:
64:         _assert(worker.creation_time == primitives._creation_time(worker.process), "dummy_process_identity_changed")
65:         process = primitives._owned(worker.process)
66:         _assert(primitives.api.call("WaitForSingleObject", process, MAX_WAIT_MS) == WAIT_OBJECT_0,
67:                 "dummy_process_exit_not_observed")
68:         exit_code = primitives.api.ffi.c_uint32()
69:         primitives.api.checked("GetExitCodeProcess", process, primitives.api.ffi.byref(exit_code))
70:         _assert(exit_code.value == expected_exit, "generated_child_exit_differs_from_fixed_case")
71:         accounting = primitives.api.structure("JOBOBJECT_BASIC_ACCOUNTING_INFORMATION")
72:         returned = primitives.api.ffi.c_uint32()
73:         primitives.api.checked("QueryInformationJobObject", primitives._owned(worker.job), JOB_BASIC_ACCOUNTING_CLASS,
74:             primitives.api.ffi.byref(accounting), primitives.api.ffi.sizeof(accounting), primitives.api.ffi.byref(returned))
75:         _assert(returned.value == primitives.api.ffi.sizeof(accounting) and accounting.active_processes == 0,
76:                 "dummy_owned_job_not_empty")
77:         worker.quiescent = True
78:         return {"child_native_exit": int(exit_code.value), "process_wait_observed": True, "job_active_processes": 0}
79:     except BaseException:
80:         worker.unconfirmed = True
81:         worker.read_set.unconfirmed = True
82:         raise

88:     Inputs must come from the future exact generated-only launcher. This class

93:     def __init__(self, primitives, pipes, expectations, executable, arguments,

98:         _assert(type(case) is str and case in ("positive", "wrong_identity"), "fixed_generated_case")
99:         _assert(namespace_sha256 == namespace_digest(), "fixed_generated_namespace")
100:         self.case = case
101:         self.expected_exit = 0 if case == "positive" else 2
102:         self.adoption_response = None
103:         self.adoption_payload = None
104:         self.primitives, self.pipes, self.expectations = primitives, pipes, expectations

108:         self.lifecycle = SnapshotLifecycle(self)
